name: MBU deposit() price-scale mint inflation
summary: The MobiusDAO deposit proxy's deposit(token, amount) values the deposit as amount x oracle token price without dividing out the 18-decimal price scale, then mints value x 1e18 / MBU price, so it mints 1e18 times the correct MBU. A 0.001 WBNB deposit (0.657 USD at the oracle's 656.92 USD/BNB) minted 9731099570720980.659843835099042677 MBU instead of 0.00973 MBU; selling 28,500,000 of them into the MBU/USDT PancakeSwap pair drained 2,157,126 USDT. Copycats repeated the same 0.001 WBNB deposit ten more times.

loss.notes: Gross USDT depletion of the MBU/USDT PancakeSwap V2 pair 0xb5252fcef718f8629f81f1dfcff869594ad478c6 caused by bug-minted MBU. Component 1 is the anchor transaction (attacker 0xb32a53af96f7735d47f4b76c525bd5eb02b42600). Component 2 merges later actors repeating the same deposit(WBNB, 1e15) path between blocks 49470431 and 49475087: 1809.975661133888705413 USDT drained inside seven later deposit transactions plus 634.791782021593824162 USDT from nine separate Universal Router sells by 0x89f4e21c62e0fb52c8445e842781e77fe333f50d of MBU it minted in 0x84674f8b0ac41b8870b79e51abc4ea491ebf97f02f57d45241073d7cac364dee. The 0.001 WBNB inputs are attacker-supplied and not netted; unsold bug-minted MBU and the 1,000,000 bug-minted MBU that 0xa5eabc3b36dba37593352a00ce8b7720da6fc624 staked and later unstaked are not counted. Small later pair outflows to unrelated addresses (12.01 USDT to 0x0fccab6848d59c45b758dc1c9057e618b157231f and multi-hop swaps via 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae) have unestablished MBU provenance and are excluded. Nothing was recovered.

ageReset.description: The proxy's first Upgraded event, log 129 of its own ERC1967Proxy creation transaction, selected implementation 0x637d8ce897bb653cb83ba436cdf76bbe158f05b1; the EIP-1967 implementation slot still reads that address at block 49470429. The next Upgraded event (the fix) is at block 49495855, after the campaign.

sources.note: Root cause and earliest exercise. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 49470430, index 1): EOA 0xb32a53af -> attacker contract 0x631adff0 (selector 0xcd60b03d) -> WBNB deposit() 0.001 BNB, approve(0x95e92b09), then 0x95e92b09.deposit(0xbb4cdb9c...WBNB, 1e15) (selector 0x47e7ef24) -> DELEGATECALL 0x637d8ce8. The implementation STATICCALLs oracle proxy 0x4cbbb1b6ab63b6b01f9309b0aa53a05962a4a66b (impl 0xb9d3bb65aacd77ba6033f92cef043b979d9c10d4): 0x456e08e2 returns 656921601740811896377 (BNB/USD, 18-dec, from WBNB/USDT pair 0x16b9a828 reserves) and 0x769b6f30 returns 67507438082060469494 (MBU/USD, 18-dec, from MBU/USDT pair 0xb5252fce reserves). It pulls 1e15 WBNB and calls MBU token 0x0dfb6ac3a8ea88d058be219066931db2bee9a581.mint(0x631adff0, 9731099570720980659843835099042677). The proxy's Deposit event (topic0 0x36af321ec8d3c75236829c5317affd40ddb308863a1236d2d277a4025cccee1e, log 6, indexed token WBNB) carries data words [1e15, 656921601740811896377000000000000000, 9731099570720980659843835099042677]: word2 equals exactly amount*bnbPrice (no /1e18) and word3 equals exactly floor(word2*1e18/mbuPrice); with the missing /1e18 the mint is 9731099570720980 wei (0.00973 MBU). The oracle returns 18-decimal prices by design and was created at block 49326825, before the deposit proxy, with a single Upgraded event in its creation tx (0xc43d8f0dd56272ea99fb0d7a465a86251b6a1d58e0914c3e738e3f480bb7706d); its only later tx 0x66ea4f37 (5d428e08) does not change the implementation. The attacker contract then sells 30,000,000 MBU (1,500,000 fee to 0x44bf47b8, 28,500,000 to the pair) via PancakeRouter 0x10ed43c7 swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens; pair log 16 transfers 2157126.179348943736411799 USDT to 0xb32a53af. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs for address 0x95e92b09, blocks 0..99999999, two pages (1821 logs) contain 11 Deposit events, the first being source-1 log 6; none precede it. account.txlist for the proxy (16 txs) shows no earlier deposit call; pre-exploit admin calls were addMinter x5, 0x7623df4c x2, depositMBU(uint256) x2 and 0x8ccbdf89 x2. The implementation is unverified on BscScan; the defect characterisation rests on this exact trace arithmetic, consistent with source-2.

Target identity and age history. Proxy 0x95e92b09 created by the same deployer in source-3 (block 49326835, index 18); eth_getCode empty at 49326834; proxy runtime keccak 0xee8a1059...6dd9 identical at 49326835 and 49470429. Proxy Upgraded logs over full history: exactly two, source-3 log 0x81 (129) selecting 0x637d8ce8 and 0x6a7ae7d97091c9d254c9d976be7761759dfcd44f187a13fcfd1d1eb3ca46217f log 0x103 at block 49495855 selecting 0x5713291f (post-campaign fix). EIP-1967 slot 0x3608...2bbc reads 0x637d8ce8 at 49470429 and at 49495854. Critical state read by deposit(): oracle slot 0xa = 0x4cbbb1b6 and WBNB-enabled mapping slot keccak(WBNB,13) = 0x87caf390...2309 = 1, both written in the creation tx (prestateTracer diffMode on source-3) and unchanged at 49470429. Post-creation admin txs (account.txlist): addMinter x5; 0x7623df4c(address) x2 writing mapping entries for 0x750d0ba3... and 0x02a4887e... (not WBNB, oracle or implementation); depositMBU x2 (team USDT/MBU funding); 0x8ccbdf89 x2 raising slot 0xb, an accumulator that deposit() increments by the deposit value, not a price, scale or enable flag. None is necessary to the missing price-scale division, so implementation activation at proxy creation is the latest reset; age 1746948826 - 1746733429 = 215397 s. Deployer is unrelated to the attacker EOAs.
